name: Purphoros
description: A god of Theros whose fury knocked Polukranos from the stars and who forged the Champion's spear in the story.

description_citations.text: "Ajani, Mentor of Heroes" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Dec 2014.

timeline.summary: Iris gallops carelessly away from Alexio, and he swoops down and saves her from an ambush by two men he believes are worshipers of Purphoros; her horse is lamed and put down.
timeline.quote: Judging by the markings on their weapons, I would guess they were worshipers of Purphoros.

citation.text: "The Oracle of Ephara" by Jeremiah Isgur. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Mar 2014.

pages_say.description: A god of the forge who offered to forge Adrasteia a new set of shears, a joke her sisters cackled over for thirty-three years.

citation.text: "Emonberry Red" by Clayton Kroh. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Feb 2014.

pages_say.description: A god whose worshipers and renegade factions threaten to provoke war.

citation.text: "The Oracle of Ephara" by Jeremiah Isgur. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Mar 2014.
